question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A loud appeal or demand
solution:
The correct answer is option 3), i.e., 'Clamour.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of the marked option:
 
• Clamour: to make a loud complaint or demand. (जोर से शिकायत या मांग करना) 
 
 
• Example: *People began to **clamour **for his resignation.*
 
 
 
• ​Let's look at the meanings of the other given options:
 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 Protest
 a strong complaint expressing disagreement, disapproval, or opposition. (असहमति, अस्वीकृति या विरोध व्यक्त करने वाली एक मजबूत शिकायत)
 
 

 Entourage
 the group of people who travel with and work for an important or famous person. (लोगों का समूह जो किसी महत्वपूर्ण या प्रसिद्ध व्यक्ति के साथ यात्रा करता है और उसके लिए काम करता है)
 
 

 Gambit
 a clever action in a game or other situation that is intended to achieve an advantage and usually involves taking a risk. (एक खेल या अन्य स्थिति में एक चतुर कार्रवाई जिसका उद्देश्य लाभ प्राप्त करना है और आमतौर पर जोखिम लेना शामिल होता है)
 
 
 
 
 
• Hence, from the given meanings, we find that 'Clamour' is the correct one-word substitute.
 
• So, the correct answer is option 3.
